readme: Per-item record of the second model-study leg published in docs/narrative-evidence-v1.md (Second model study). This leg is NOT the paired frontier leg the first study's limits paragraph calls for: it shares no file with leg 1, so no paired per-item difference is defined against it, and the pairing requirement stays open. run holds the non-derivable provenance pins: model, endpoint, prompt version, and this leg's own per-repo subject commits (the leg spans six repositories, 34 files each; item paths are prefixed with the repo name). items holds one record per file: the verdict of each of the 3 generations (vocabulary grounded | uncited, where uncited is the checker's contains-uncited-claims stamp and is the equivalent of leg 1's flagged), the uncited tokens the run-1 stamp names, and narrative_sha16 — the first 16 hex chars of a sha256 of each generation narrative. Three caveats the aggregates depend on. (1) The stamp previews at most 5 tokens and items with more carry a trailing …+N marker recorded from the stamp's "(+N more)" suffix; this leg is truncated on 150 of 204 items, so token-count aggregates recover the total as named + N and must not use the stamp-named count alone, which understates this leg by 2.09x. (2) --llm-refresh overwrites one sidecar key three times, so only the third generation's narrative survives on disk: sha16 is present for generation 3 and null elsewhere, and the byte-identity comparison leg 1 reports cannot be reproduced here. Verdicts are complete for all three generations, so the flip rate is unaffected. (3) temperature and seed were not sent by the client and are therefore unpinned, and the run is not reproducible from the record alone; a reproducible rerun should send them explicitly and encode them in the model id as model:deepseek-v4-pro-t0-sNN-p1. The doc recomputes all aggregates from items; this file stores no derived statistics.
